title: Coco public-data curriculum manifest
architecture_requirement: Use Coco native learning; no requirement for transformer, backpropagation, semantic parser or external planner.

source_registry.name: Dyna-bAbI
source_registry.license_note: Repository lists CC0-1.0. Verify terms separately for inherited original bAbI downloads.
source_registry.adapter: Stream story observations; control entity vocabulary and skill mixtures; keep solver/support annotations teacher-only.

source_registry.name: Original bAbI task generator
source_registry.license_note: Check terms of the exact dataset archive separately from generator code.
source_registry.adapter: Use task definitions and public data for coverage not supplied by the selected Dyna-bAbI configuration.

source_registry.name: CLEVR and CoGenT
source_registry.adapter: Use no-image archives; verbalize scene graphs; programs and answers are teacher-only. This is a text adaptation, not official visual CLEVR.

source_registry.name: COGS
source_registry.license_note: Repository lists MIT. Record the exact data snapshot.
source_registry.adapter: Use corrected data, and distinguish in-distribution test.tsv from generalization gen.tsv. Formal targets are an optional supervised diagnostic.

source_registry.name: SCAN
source_registry.adapter: Keep official length and add-primitive splits separate; this tests command composition rather than world-state grounding.

source_registry.name: TextWorld
source_registry.license_note: TextWorld code: MIT. Dependencies have separate licenses; do not infer asset terms from code.
source_registry.adapter: Generate worlds and collect rollouts; learner gets observations, own actions and feedback, not hidden facts, walkthroughs or oracle plans.

source_registry.name: LLM-BabyBench
source_registry.adapter: Start with Predict; create grouped splits using level and seed metadata, plus task-family holdouts. Do not assume the displayed train partition is a complete evaluation protocol.

source_registry.name: BabyAI in MiniGrid
source_registry.license_note: Review the pinned MiniGrid code and asset licenses.
source_registry.adapter: Preserve the selected observation regime when serializing to text; do not expose the full grid in a partial-observation evaluation.

source_registry.name: ProPara
source_registry.license_note: Repository lists Apache 2.0; verify coverage of the exact data artifact before ingestion.
source_registry.adapter: Use sentence-prefix state tracking; withhold future sentences and evaluation state annotations.

source_registry.name: Schema-Guided Dialogue and SGD-X
source_registry.adapter: Reconstruct turns and service results; create a mock backend for interactive task verification. SGD-X varies schemas, not all dialogue utterances.

source_registry.name: OpenAssistant OASST1
source_registry.adapter: Select English, reviewed nondeleted messages and quality branches; split all paths from one message_tree_id together.

source_registry.name: SmolTalk selected subsets
source_registry.license_note: Newly produced subsets described in the card are Apache 2.0; imported components retain their own terms. Do not treat all as one license.
source_registry.adapter: Begin with smol-rewrite and smol-summarize; retain source text, audit outputs, and do not treat synthetic replies as a truth oracle.

source_registry.name: CLUTRR
source_registry.adapter: Optional kinship-chain diagnostic only after permission review; no assumption that evaluation use is automatically exempt.

source_registry.name: TinyStories
source_registry.adapter: Optional later fluency input, not an oracle for consistent world state.

source_registry.name: SQuAD 2.0
source_registry.adapter: Use supplied passages and unanswerable questions before broad factual chat; do not confuse passage support with world truth.

default_pre_chat_learning_budget.unit: measured learning events or bytes/tokens; record the selected unit

notes: This manifest is configuration guidance, not an executable training pipeline.
Pin revisions and validate license coverage and oracle correctness before ingestion.
Natural-language and text-rendered adaptations are not official visual/embodied benchmark scores.
Source licenses describe the reviewed scope, not blanket commercial-use clearance.
